name: @papillon6814/pi-gh
description: Prepare and approve GitHub issue workflows inside Pi

scripts.typecheck: npm run build && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.extension.json
scripts.test:core: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test dist/test/core/*.test.js
scripts.test:service: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test dist/test/service*.test.js
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test dist/test/core/*.test.js dist/test/service*.test.js dist/test/package.test.js test/*.test.mjs
